Aur jagah hai: (Wa min ayatihi an yursilar-riaha mubashshiratin wa liyuzuqakum min rahmatihi wa litajriyal-fulku bi amrihi wa litabtaghu min fadlihi wa la'allakum tashkurun) (Ar-Rum: 46) al-akh, apni rehmat se peshtar is ki khushkhabri dene wali thandi thandi hawaain woh chalata hai. (Asifat) se bhi murad hawaain hain, woh narm halki aur bheeni bheeni hawaain theen, yeh zara tez jhonkon wali aur aawaz wali hawaain hain. Nashirat se murad bhi hawaain hain jo badlon ko aasman mein har chaar so phaila deti hain aur jidhar Allah ka hukum hota hai unhein le jati hain. Taake hai jis din tum sab ke sab awwal o akhir wale apni apni qabron se dobara zinda kiye jaoge aur apne kartoot ka phal paoge, neki ki jaza aur badi ki saza paoge, soor phonk diya jayega aur ek chatyal maidaan mein tum sab jamah kar diye jaoge, yeh waada yaqinan haq hai aur ho kar rehne wala aur lazmi taur par aane wala hai.

Phir farmata hai yeh faisle ka din hai agle pichle sab yahan jama hain agar tum kisi chaalaki, makari, hoshyari aur fareb-dehi se mere qabze se nikal sakte ho toh nikal jao poori koshish karlo. Khayal farmaiye ke kis qadr dil hila dene wala fiqra hai, Parvardigar-e-Aalam khud Roz-e-Qiyamat un munkiron se farmaye ga ke ab khamosh kyun ho ? Woh ayyari, chaalaki aur be-baki kya hui ? Dekho main ne tum sab ko ek maidan mein hasb-e-wada jama kar diya aaj agar kisi hikmat se mujh se chhoot sakte ho toh kami na karo, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Yā ma‘shara al-jinni wal-insi inistata‘tum an tanfudū min aqṭāris-samāwāti wal-arḍi fanfudū lā tanfudūna illā bi-sulṭānin) (Ar-Rahman: 33) yaani اے جن وانس کے گروہ اگر تم آسمان و زمین کے کناروں سے باہر چلے جانے کی طاقت رکھتے ho toh nikal jao magar itna samajh lo ke baghair quwat ke tum bahar nahi ja sakte aur woh tum mein nahi aur jagah hai ayat (Wa lā taḍurrunahu shayan inna rabbī ‘alā kulli shay'in ḥafīẓun) (Hud: 57).

Hazrat Abu Abdullah Jadli farmate hain ke main Bait-ul-Muqaddas gaya, dekha ke wahan Hazrat Ubadah bin Samit R.A aur Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr R.A aur Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar R.A baithe hue baatein kar rahe hain, main bhi baith gaya. Toh maine suna ke Hazrat Ubadah farmate hain: Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala tamam aglo pichlo ko ek chatil saaf maidan mein jama karega, aawaz dene wala aawaz dekar sab ko hoshyar kar dega. Phir Allah Ta'ala farmayega: "Aaj ka din faislo ka din hai, tum sab agle pichlo ko maine jama kar diya hai, ab main tumse kehta hoon ke agar mere sath koi dagha, fareb, makr, hila kar sakte ho toh kar lo."

Suno! Mutakabir, sarkash, munkar aur jhutlane wala aaj meri pakar se bach nahi sakta aur na koi nafarman shaitan mere azabo se najat pa sakta hai.

Hazrat Abdullah R.A ne farmaya: "Lo, ek Hadith main bhi suna doon, is din Jahannam apni gardan daraz karke logo ke beecho beech pahunch kar ba-aawaz-e-buland kahegi: Aey logo! Teen qism ke logo ko abhi hi pakar lene ka mujhe hukum mil chuka hai, main unhe khoob pehchanti hu, koi baap apni aulaad ko aur koi bhai apne bhai ko utna na janta hoga jitna main unhe pehchanti hu, aaj na toh woh mujh se kahin chhup sakte hain na koi unhe chhupa sakta hai."

Allah ki nafarmaniyon se haram kariyon se bachte thay woh Qiyamat ke din jannaton mein honge, jahan qism qism ki nahrein chal rahi hain. Gunahgar siyah badbu dar dhuwein mein ghare hue honge aur yeh naik kirdar jannaton ke ghane thande aur pur-kaif sayon mein ba-aram tamam lete baithe honge. Haan jhutlane walon ki to aaj bari kharabi hai un jhutlane walon ko dhamkaya jata hai ke acha duniya mein to tum kuch khaa pi lo, barat bartalo, fayde uthalo, anqareeb yeh neamatein bhi fana ho jayengi aur tum bhi maut ke ghat utroge. Phir tumhara nateja Jahannam hi hai jis ka zikar upar guzar chuka hai. Tumhari bad-aamaliyon aur siyah-kariyon ki saza hamare paas tayyar hai koi mujrim hamari nigah se bahar nahi, Qiyamat ko, hamare Nabi ﷺ ko hamari wahi ko na manne wala use jhoota janne wala Qiyamat ke din sakht nuqsan mein aur poore khasare mein hoga. Usi ki sakht kharabi hogi. Jaise aur jagah irshad hai ayat (Numatti'uhum qaleelan thumma nudtarruhum ila azabin ghaleez) (Luqman: 24) Duniya mein hum unhe thoda sa fayda pohncha denge phir to hum unhe sakht azab ki taraf be-bas kar denge aur jagah farman hai (Qul innal-lazeena yaftaroona 'alal-lahi al-kaziba la yuflihoon) (Yunus: 69) Yani Allah Ta'ala par jhoot bandhne wala kamyab nahi ho sakte. Duniya mein yunhi sa fayda utha lein phir un ka lotna to hamari hi taraf hai, hum unhe un ke kufr ki saza mein sakht-tar azab chakhayenge. Phir farmaya ke un nadan munkaron ko jab kaha jata hai ke aao Allah ke samne jhuk to lo, jama'at ke sath namaz to ada kar lo to un se yeh bhi nahi ho sakta, is se bhi ji churate hain balke ise haqarat se dekhte hain aur takabbur ke sath inkar kar dete hain. Un ke liye jo jhutlane mein umrein guzar dete hain Qiyamat ke din bari museebat hogi. Phir farmaya jab yeh log is pak Kalam Majeed par bhi iman nahi late to phir kis kalam ko manenge? Jaise aur jagah hai (Fa bi-ayyi hadeethin ba'dal-lahi wa ayatihi yu'minoon) (Al-Jathiyah: 6) Yani Allah Ta'ala par aur is ki aayaton par jab yeh iman na laye to ab kis baat par iman layenge?
